body_markdown:
Ridgepost Capital recently joined NYSE Texas for the grand opening of its Dallas headquarters. As a founding listed company on the exchange, Ridgepost Capital is proud to be part of the continued evolution of Texas’ capital markets.


Since launching in 2025, NYSE Texas has grown to more than 120 listed securities, underscoring the momentum building across the state’s financial services industry. As a Texas-based company, Ridgepost Capital values the opportunities created by a growing capital markets ecosystem and Dallas’ continued emergence as a leading financial center.
